dedupe_keys.name: astir tirana geopackage with urban morphology indicators and generated public space scenarios

description: This dataset is a GeoPackage of the Astir neighbourhood of Tirana, Albania, with calculated urban morphology indicators, supporting a study in generative urban design that puts public open space at the centre of neighbourhood design. It was deposited on figshare on 25 August 2026 by Anna Yunitsyna and Kledina Sallaku. Astir's parcel sizes, street types, building heights and forms and the distribution of open spaces are used as references; a rule-based Grasshopper model takes the urban morphology indicators as variables and open space indicators as constraints to produce six public space distribution scenarios. The courtyard scenario has the highest built area (38 per cent), the random park scenario the largest open space ratio (69 per cent), and the boulevard and central park scenarios the best accessibility and visibility. Coverage is the Astir neighbourhood. Access: one GeoPackage of about 93 MB on figshare. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the layers of the GeoPackage were not listed in the metadata read; the scenario geometries may be in the associated paper, not the file. Simulation uses: testing public space layouts and density options in neighbourhood planning models. Related records: the Montreal and URBREATH 3-30-300 indicators.
